Keep the original hands and skirt armor undisturbed.
Style: high-detail premium anime game character illustration with clean anatomical drawing, consistent surface shading and metallic detail, no photorealism.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no gradient, no glow, no floor, no cast shadow, no checkerboard painted into the image.
